# milvaion_job (Resource)

A Milvaion scheduled job.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A recurring job.
resource "milvaion_job" "invoice_report" {
  name            = "nightly-invoice-report"
  description     = "Sends yesterday's invoices to finance"
  tags            = ["billing", "reports"]
  worker_id       = "reporter-worker"
  job_name        = "InvoiceReportJob"
  cron_expression = "0 0 2 * * *" # six fields, seconds first

  job_data = jsonencode({
    recipients = ["finance@example.com"]
    format     = "pdf"
  })

  concurrent_execution_policy = "Skip"
  execution_timeout_seconds   = 900

  auto_disable = {
    threshold              = 5
    failure_window_minutes = 60
  }
}

# A one-time job.
resource "milvaion_job" "migration" {
  name       = "one-off-migration"
  worker_id  = "sample-worker"
  job_name   = "MigrateJob"
  execute_at = "2030-12-01T22:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `auto_disable` (Attributes) Switch the job off after repeated failures. Leave it out to keep whatever the server has. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auto_disable))
- `concurrent_execution_policy` (String) What happens when a run is due while the previous one is still running: Skip or Queue. Defaults to Skip.
- `cron_expression` (String) Six-field cron expression, seconds first: "0 0 2 * * *" runs at 02:00 every day.
- `description` (String) Free text shown in the dashboard.
- `execute_at` (String) RFC 3339 time of a one-time run. Ignored when cron_expression is set. Changing it replaces the job.
- `execution_timeout_seconds` (Number) Seconds a run may take before the worker cancels it. Unset uses the worker default.
- `external_job_id` (String) Identifier in the external scheduler. Required when is_external is true. Changing it replaces the job.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the scheduler dispatches the job. Defaults to true.
- `is_external` (Boolean) The job runs in an external scheduler (Quartz, Hangfire) and only reports to Milvaion. Changing it replaces the job.
- `job_data` (String) JSON payload passed to the job. Use jsonencode({...}).
- `job_name` (String) Job type on the worker, e.g. SendEmailJob.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags. They must not contain commas.
- `worker_id` (String) Worker that runs the job. Changing it replaces the job.
- `zombie_timeout_minutes` (Number) Minutes a run may stay queued before it is marked failed. Unset uses the server default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Job id.

<a id="nestedatt--auto_disable"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_disable`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to true.
- `failure_window_minutes` (Number) Window the failures are counted in. Unset uses the server default.
- `threshold` (Number) Failures in the window that disable the job. Unset uses the server default.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a job by its id (shown by `milvaion get jobs` and in the dashboard URL).
terraform import milvaion_job.invoice_report 01a1d6f5-59e0-7465-9423-a145e95a45a1
```
